macros.name: FirstIndexLetterEnable
macros.doc: The command \FirstIndexLetterEnable enables the package behavior.

macros.name: FirstIndexLetterSeparateDzs
macros.doc: The command \FirstIndexLetterSeparateDzs automatically enables the separate treatment of Dz too.

macros.name: IndexInitialFamily
macros.doc: The macro \IndexInitialFamily stores the font family and style used for the enlarged initial.

macros.name: IndexInitialSize
macros.doc: The initial size is controlled by \IndexInitialSize. The package default is \LARGE.

macros.name: IndexKerningAscenders
macros.doc: The list \IndexKerningAscenders contains second letters with ascenders: h, l, b, k, d, t, i. When such a letter follows the large initial, the package uses the milder ascender-specific spacing value.
